MESSAGE: Wait, what's standing on the beach?
It's the statue of a thing that saved the vacation?
Alright... I've heard everyone also did well...
Even the three... But they are... gone.
It's time to give condolences to the fallen.
I'll miss you, legends, who helped take the troopers down in the circus.
Especially for BlueTheCircley, with his water powers that wiped away an entire troop crowd.
